gloss: award history; record of awards won

definitions.gloss: award history; record of prizes won
definitions.explanation: A record or list of the prizes and awards a person or work has received over time.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{華|はな}やかな{受賞歴|じゅしょうれき}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: He has a brilliant award history.

examples.japanese: {受賞歴|じゅしょうれき}を{履歴書|りれきしょ}に{書|か}く。
examples.english: To list one's award history on a résumé.

examples.japanese: この{監督|かんとく}は{国際|こくさい}{映画祭|えいがさい}での{受賞歴|じゅしょうれき}が{豊富|ほうふ}だ。
examples.english: This director has an extensive record of awards at international film festivals.

notes:
Composed of {受賞|じゅしょう} (winning a prize) + {歴|れき} (record, history). The suffix {歴|れき} marks a track record, as in {職歴|しょくれき} (work history) or {学歴|がくれき} (educational background).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受賞歴|じゅしょうれき}がある: to have a record of awards
- {華|はな}やかな{受賞歴|じゅしょうれき}: a glittering award history
- {受賞歴|じゅしょうれき}を{誇|ほこ}る: to boast an impressive award record

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受賞|じゅしょう}: winning a prize — a single act, not the cumulative record
- {実績|じっせき}: track record, achievements — broader than awards alone
